root_cause.text: `bpf_core_parse_spec()` parses CO-RE accessor indices using `sscanf` with `%d` but fails to validate that the parsed index is non-negative, allowing negative values to bypass subsequent bounds checks due to C integer promotion and trigger an out-of-bounds read.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `if (access_idx < 0) return -EINVAL;` immediately after `sscanf(spec_str, "%d%n", &access_idx, &parsed_len)`, and the commit message explains that negative indices like -1 bypass the `access_idx >= btf_vlen(t)` check because C integer promotion converts the `__u16` result of `btf_vlen` to `int`, making `(int)(-1) >= (int)(N)` false.
